mainDressCode.title: Dress Code
mainDressCode.description: We kindly invite our guests to wear warm, elegant tones or dusty blue. Kindly reserve white for the bride only.

sections.title: Guests
sections.description: Please wear any warm color or dusty blue — soft neutrals, earth tones, warm pastels, and dusty blue are all welcome. White is reserved for the bride only on our wedding day.
